headline: China's Auto Manufacturing Receivables Approach 3 Trillion Yuan Amid Price War
summary: Outstanding receivables in China's auto manufacturing sector neared 3 trillion yuan ($450 billion) as prolonged price wars squeeze suppliers' finances and cash flow.
why: China's automotive sector is undergoing fierce price competition that pressures profit margins across manufacturers and component suppliers.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Extended collection periods and high receivables increase liquidity pressures on auto parts suppliers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
